news.title: CEIGALL: New Energy And Highway Orders Will Support Steady Future Outlook
news.body: Analysts have kept Ceigall India's fair value estimate effectively unchanged at ₹331. This reflects only very small tweaks to inputs such as the discount rate, long term revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E assumptions rather than any shift in their core view on the stock.

news.title: CEIGALL: New Infrastructure Orders Will Support Steady Outlook And Balanced Prospects
news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for Ceigall India steady at ₹331, reflecting only minor tweaks to the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E inputs in their models rather than a meaningful change in conviction. What's in the News Received two EPC work orders from Purvah Green Power in Andhra Pradesh covering a 220 kV transmission line and balance of plant works for a 300.3 MW hybrid wind project, with a combined order value of about ₹2,980 million including GST and a 10 month construction period (client announcement).

news.title: CEIGALL: Major Road And Metro Wins Will Support Future Re Rating
news.body: Analysts have maintained the fair value estimate for Ceigall India at ₹331, citing only marginal tweaks to assumptions such as the discount rate and future P/E that do not materially change their overall view. What's in the News Ceigall India, in joint venture with Sushee Infra & Mining, has emerged as the L1 bidder for four EPC road projects on the NH 913 Frontier Highway in Arunachal Pradesh, with a combined bid cost of ₹21,496.2 million and construction periods of 36 to 48 months, plus 5 year maintenance obligations for each project (Client Announcements).

news.title: CEIGALL: Large New Infrastructure Orders Will Support Future Re Rating
news.body: Analysts have lifted their price target on Ceigall India from ₹296 to ₹331. They point to updated assumptions on revenue growth, profit margins, discount rate and future P/E as key drivers of the revised view.

news.title: Price target increased by 14% to ₹331
news.body: Up from ₹290, the current price target is an average from 2 analysts. New target price is 22% above last closing price of ₹272. Stock is up 12% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹15.75 for next year compared to ₹17.48 last year.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹4.16 (vs ₹4.06 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.16 (up from ₹4.06 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹10.0b (up 21% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹741.1m (up 1.3% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 7.4% (down from 8.8% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 15% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 14% growth forecast for the Construction industry in India.

news.title: An undisclosed buyer entered into a non-binding offer letter to acquire Ceigall Malout Abohar Sadhuwali Highways Private Limited from Ceigall India Limited (NSEI:CEIGALL).
news.body:
An undisclosed buyer entered into a non-binding offer letter to acquire Ceigall Malout Abohar Sadhuwali Highways Private Limited from Ceigall India Limited (NSEI:CEIGALL) on January 13, 2026.

The transaction is subject to consummation of due diligence investigation and definitive agreement.
